reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a uni-tranche loan facility of up to EUR 75 million in favour of DL Invest Group E Sp. z o. o. (the "Borrower"), incorporated in Poland, to develop and operate build-to-suit industrial and logistics projects (the "Sub-Projects" and taken together the "Project") in regional cities in Poland. DL Invest Group PM S.A. (the "Client") owns 100% of the Borrower and will act as the developer of the Project. The EBRD secured InvestEU's first loss guarantee for the transaction.The EBRD is a leading implementing partner for the EU's InvestEU programme, which supports sustainable investment, innovation and job creation in the European Union. It aims to trigger more than €372 billion in additional investment between 2021 and 2027. Between 2022 and 2027 InvestEU guarantees worth €777 million will be leveraged by the EBRD to finance investments of up to €2.7 billion in eligible sectors The EBRD funding will support the development and operation of the Sub-Projects.
